operations.title: Theta reflection compression is spectrally too smooth for xi
operations.statement: Compressing the reflected theta convolution to the positive logarithmic half-line gives a source-derived self-adjoint trace-class Hankel operator with discrete spectrum. Its smooth rapidly decreasing kernel forces singular values to decay faster than every power, so the reciprocal eigenvalues—the zeros of det(I-zH)—have count O_epsilon(R^epsilon), incompatible with the R log R zero density of completed xi.
operations.scope: Determinant no-go for the canonical smooth theta Hankel compression and affine rescalings; does not exclude singular or energy-dependent prime-coupled systems.
